name: feature.creative-video.nodes
description: AI video node pack (ADR 0404) — `generate` (avatar script→MP4 via the HeyGen-class provider), `text-to-video` (frontier text→video, ADR 0404 §P4, behind the creative-video.t2v sub-toggle), and `status`. All ride the Connections broker (async submit→poll→download→media asset; ADR 0106 cost-metered; replay-safe — the asset id is the recorded output, never a regenerate). Over ctx.features['creative-video']; adapterOnly consumer of the heygen + runway providers. v1.2.0 (ADR 0945 D8): generate and text-to-video are role:side-effect + side-effectful, so a :fork serves the recorded asset instead of submitting a second paid job. v1.3.0 (ADR 0945 D7) adds image-to-video: animate a checked product shot or one of the product's own photos on the same job pipeline; every product video is needs_review until frames can be sampled. v1.4.0 (ADR 1051): the spend nodes need workspace:write and a person behind the run; generate needs that person's own likeness-consent attestation for the avatar (made on the AI Video page); text/image-to-video take an optional ratio and refuse a model, ratio or duration the host's model table does not list, before any spend; a host refusal (forbidden_scope, likeness_consent_required, validation_error) is passed through as the node's error code.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: AI Video: Generate
nodes.description: Generates an avatar video from a script over ctx.features['creative-video'].generateVideo (async: submit → bounded-poll → download → media asset). Inputs: { orgId, script, avatarId, voiceId? }. Output: { success, status: 'completed'|'pending'|'failed', jobId, assetId? } — on completion the output is the MEDIA ASSET ID (replay returns it, never regenerates). Cost-metered (ADR 0106 video, reserved before the submit); the governed spend rides the adapterOnly heygen provider. ADR 1051: needs workspace:write on the org, a person behind the run, and that person's own likeness-consent attestation for this avatar and voice (made once on the AI Video page); otherwise it fails likeness_consent_required before anything is sent. role:side-effect (ADR 0945 D8): a :fork serves the recorded output instead of generating (and paying) again.

nodes.label: AI Video: Text-to-Video
nodes.description: Generates a video directly from a text prompt with a frontier text-to-video model (Runway/Veo/Sora-class) over ctx.features['creative-video'].textToVideo (async: submit → bounded-poll → download → media asset). Inputs: { orgId, prompt, model?, ratio?, durationSec? } — model, ratio and duration must be ones the host's model table lists (GET the AI Video page's model list); anything else fails validation_error before any spend. Output: { success, status: 'completed'|'pending'|'failed', jobId, assetId? } — the asset id is the recorded output (replay returns it). Gated by the creative-video.t2v sub-toggle (AND the parent); metered at a heavier weight against the ADR 0106 daily video budget; governed spend rides the adapterOnly runway provider. role:side-effect (ADR 0945 D8): a :fork serves the recorded output instead of generating (and paying) again.

nodes.label: Video: Image to Video
nodes.description: ADR 0945 D7 — animates a still into a short video on the SAME async job pipeline as text-to-video (one job store, one spend meter, the operator's frontier-video connection). The still must be a checked product shot (a composite or edit whose stored verdict is pass) or one of the product's own photos (pass productId); any other image is refused product_depiction_ungrounded, and a still over 3.5 MB is refused before any spend. Every product video is needs_review: frames cannot be sampled on this host yet, so the publish gate holds it for a person. Inputs: { orgId, sourceAssetId, prompt, productId?, model?, ratio?, durationSec? } (ADR 1051: from the host's model table). Output: { status: 'completed'|'pending'|'failed', jobId, assetId?, outcome? ('needs_review') } — pending is resolved by the status node. Behind creative-video.t2v. role:side-effect: a :fork serves the recorded asset instead of submitting a second paid job.

nodes.label: AI Video: Job Status
nodes.description: Reads a video job's status over ctx.features['creative-video'].getVideoStatus — resolves a `pending` generate into its final asset id once the provider finishes. Inputs: { orgId, jobId }. Output: { success, status, assetId?, error? }.
